name: femur_loading
description: Synthetic proximal-femur voxel model under 3x body-weight stance loading.

materials.modulus: cortical E = 10500 * rho^2.0; trabecular E = 6850 * rho^1.49 [MPa]

boundary_conditions.load: 3.0 x body-weight (75 kg reference), traction over proximal 15% of nodes

notes: Regression anchor for the voxel-hex pipeline; not a clinical femur.
Smoothing moves surface nodes; element connectivity and materials are unaffected.
Screening context: cortical yield ~110 MPa (tpt-med-bone), so ~33% of yield.
